item: Bedroom cleanup plan (stages 1-6): gate check + no-data CPU prep for stages 1 and 3

gate.question: May the Owner's bedroom (AUTH #046) be processed on RunPod Secure Cloud?
gate.answer: Not covered. #046 limits processing to 'operator box + private Modal volume'; #039 keeps RunPod to the open-licence corpus until real-scan policy is settled; #045 provides the budget (RunPod fallback) but its data clause defers to #046.
gate.action: Filed AUTH REQUEST #051 (issue #24) for the Coordinator to log. No bedroom data moved; no GPU run; $0.
gate.box_fix: /workspace/owner-capture and work/ were 755 (#046 requires chmod 700); set to 700 on 2026-10-17.

stage1_prep.method: Voxelise SfM points (1-99 pct box / 40); per voxel: distinct observing images from tracks, angular spread of viewing rays, median Laplacian variance of the observing frames. Weak = views < 5 OR spread < 10 deg OR sharpness < frame q25. 26-connected weak regions; top-down PNG heatmaps (views / spread / sharpness); well-covered camera box for stage 6.
stage1_prep.note: On a pan-heavy video the parallax rule dominates (Winchester W01: 248/269 voxels). The threshold is a parameter; set it on the bedroom once #051 (or a box-only run under #046) allows.

stage3_prep.method: RANSAC in the up-aligned frame: floor (normal ~ up, lowest 30% heights), ceiling (top 15%), up to 6 vertical walls; least-squares refit; 2-98 pct rectangle; texture = median of the top-3 sharpest frames that see the whole rectangle within 60 deg of its normal, perspective-warped.
limits: Whole-rectangle-in-frame + 60 deg rule leaves big or grazing planes untextured (Winchester floor/ceiling); partial-view mosaicking is a follow-up.
Door/window frames (rectangles inside walls) not implemented: need edge evidence; stage-3 follow-up.
Unity composite (planes behind splats) not started: needs the stage-3 GPU/phone cycle.

tests: services/reconstruction/tests/test_coverage_planes.py (synthetic COLMAP room: weak corner found, full coverage when well seen, floor/ceiling/2 walls labelled and facing the room, perspective coefficients round-trip).
blocked: Stages 2-6 on the bedroom wait for AUTH #051 (or an Owner choice to use the private Modal volume, covered by #046 but near the Modal monthly cap). Stage 4 also needs a licence check of the M1-PIPE-02 generative model: Difix3D+ is eval-only under #045 and its outputs never ship.
